loopWidth        end if        if Xpos < -loopX then          Xpos = Xpos + loopWidth        end if        ballAngle = ballAngle + (Xvel * 2)        if ballAngle > 360 then          ballAngle = ballAngle - loopWidth  end if  if mapXPos < 0 then    mapXPos = mapXPos + loopWidth  end if  temp = (mapXPos - 0.5) mod 128  temp1 = mapXPos - temp  temp2 = integer(temp1 / 128)  mapXTile = temp2 + 1  localXPercent = (mapXPos -
